inspected_anchors.finding: PC, FCI/RFCI, GIES, IDA and adjustment criteria have distinct scopes. GPL >=2, R >=3.5, compiled Rcpp/RcppArmadillo/BH path and graph dependencies.
Ancestral-graph endpoint matrix: entry [i,j] denotes the endpoint at j; 0 absent, 1 circle, 2 arrow, 3 tail. This is not a coefficient or DAG binary adjacency matrix.
IDA requires a linear Gaussian causal model, covariance information and an estimated graph; the target is a total effect.
IDA returns a multiset of possible total effects over compatible DAGs; a multiset is not a confidence interval.
pc requires alpha and indepTest; NAdelete defaults true, m.max infinite; explicit node labels and constraints are inputs.
Stable skeleton is distinguished from orientation rules; acyclicity, sufficient information, Markov and faithfulness assumptions matter.
Orientation order dependence and conservative/majority/conflict options require separate attention; do not infer that stable skeleton fixes every orientation issue.

inspected_anchors.finding: Structure/parameter learning, interventions and counterfactuals are documented. GPL >=2; R >=4.4; compiled C17 requirement.
DirectLiNGAM exposes pwling/default and gkernel order criteria with adaptive LASSO selection; this is a functional-model route.
Intervention and counterfactual operations treat networks as causal models; availability of the operation does not validate causal assumptions.
Constraint learning has explicit CI tests/alpha and can return a partially directed graph.
Defaults depend on data type; alpha .05; incomplete data use locally complete subsets for the individual tests.
Hybrid algorithms combine restriction and score maximization rather than creating independent causal guarantees.
mmhc uses mmpc plus hc; h2pc uses hpc plus hc.
hc/tabu are score searches; data type determines the BIC default.
hc has no random restarts by default; max iterations and max parents can be unbounded; tabu length defaults 10.

sources.author: Federico Castelletti and Alessandro Mascaro

inspected_anchors.finding: Gaussian DAG structure and joint causal-effect learning; MIT plus LICENSE; graph/gRbase/Rgraphviz/mvtnorm dependencies; no package compilation declared.
causaleffect returns the total joint intervention effects for a specified Gaussian DAG and Cholesky parameters.
confint.bcdagCE explicitly computes credible, not confidence, intervals.
get_diagnostics uses traces and posterior edge-probability stability; a finite trace diagnostic does not prove convergence.
Edge-inclusion frequencies summarize the sampled posterior; [u,v] denotes u to v.
S/burn/a/U/w are explicit. fast=false is the default; fast=true approximates the proposal ratio. collapse=true omits parameter draws.
Posterior graph/parameter draws, compressed storage and MAP/MPM summaries are distinct outputs.

inspected_anchors.finding: BGe/BDe scores, order/partition MCMC, continuous/discrete and dynamic BN scope; GPL >=2; Rcpp and pcalg dependencies.
iterativeMCMC expands a PC-derived search space; retained search-space restriction affects conclusions.
Defaults include alpha .05, softlimit 9, hardlimit 12 and cpdag=false.
learnBN is a wrapper over MCMC MAP searches; plus1 expansion and iterative runs have different computation costs.
Partition sampling has explicit iteration/thinning and search-space controls; graph sampling is conditional on this configuration.

sources.title: mcmcabn structural MCMC documentation
sources.author: Gilles Kratzer and contributors

inspected_anchors.finding: Input is an abn score cache; max.parents defaults 1, seed 42, scheme c(100,1000,1000), prior.choice 2.
Structural MC3/REV/MBR moves, mixed node distributions and prior/heating choices are documented; multiple long chains are advised.
The example stores the Smoking to LungCancer prior at [LungCancer,Smoking], so package array orientation cannot be assumed from a generic DAG label.

sources.author: Federico Castelletti and Alessandro Mascaro

inspected_anchors.finding: Original preprint identifies the Gaussian structure-and-effect learning problem.
Observational equivalence motivates uncertainty over DAGs and effects.
BiDAG/mcmcabn are related R package leads; historical comparative statements require checking against current manuals.
Independent-observation Gaussian SEM factorization and conjugate prior parameters.
Compatible DAG-Wishart hyperparameters give equal marginal likelihoods to Markov-equivalent DAGs.
Skeleton prior, hard interventions and total joint-effect definition.
Intervention effect calculation and MCMC target. Interpret intervention equations with fixed intervention coordinates, not random variation in the assigned coordinates.
